test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

14, 23, 38, 59, ?, 119
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **The difference of the difference of the terms is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5712380e97ea23518d7163d80722e05989ef0bfdf45d6006bbfe0a5361907e9.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**
